## Notes

Base max energy 270, +34 per Stardrop to 508; tools cost energy; exhausted at 0 (slower actions); pass out at -15, ending the day, losing 10% of gold up to 1,000g if outside; bed after midnight cuts restoration from 2.5% at 12:10 AM to 50% at 2:00 AM.
